text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since sitting down at my desk to craft a new training regimen for <chrname>, the last few hours have flown by. I'm about to take a break when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you there, Trainer? It's Tazuna. You have a visitor. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It's Etsuko Otonashi from Twinkle Monthly. Would you happen to be available to talk at the moment?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you working? I'm sorry to disturb you.
choice_data_list: Yes, I was just thinking up a new training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A training regimen? Um, if you don't mind, may I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Pardon me…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ohh… Hm, I see. Amazing… Oh, but this is… Hmm!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …Thank you once again. That was truly fascinating!
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear your opinion on it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Mine? But I'm just a reporter. I'm not sure my thoughts would be especially insightful…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: What an amazing attitude to have! Absorbing anything and everything you can, almost like an insatiable black hole…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Then, with all due respect, I think it may prove beneficial to reconsider the shape of the cleats you've chosen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: With this running form, I think using outer-rim type cleats will alleviate some of the burden on the runner.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Also, it seems to me that stamina often becomes a point of concern for runners around this time in their careers.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: And going off your most recent lap times, it might serve you well to increase your number of ramp training sessions…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …That's all I have to note. It's only a layman's opinion, but I hope it can be of help in some small way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She certainly has a lot to say, and her observations are all incredibly insightful!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I always knew you were knowledgeable about racing, but you're a veritable wellspring of wisdom, Reporter Otonashi!
choice_data_list: You could become a trainer yourself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to hear that… But I'm quite happy being a reporter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: If I weren't a reporter, I…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh! Don't you need to discuss the magazines, Reporter Otonashi?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah! I'm terribly sorry! It's unlike me to forget my priorities!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'd like you to take a look at these magazines and let me know what you think of the announcements for the Twinkle Star Climax!
choice_data_list: Ah, was wondering what was in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There sure are a lot. And not just racing magazines either—there are Umamusume fashion and manga magazines, too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Right! And physical publications are only a small fraction of the whole picture—we've written feature articles for websites, too.
choice_data_list: All this and you're saying it's just a small fraction?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I was utterly taken aback as well!
choice_data_list: It really makes the scale of this event hit home, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: If only I could redirect your kind comments to the many companies who agreed to pitch in and help!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: However, we still have plenty more gas in the tank. The opening day of the series is still a ways away…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: And we're hoping to use that time for further promotion. I want to create the grandest racing event—one that every citizen will await with bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Well, this series is going to determine the greatest, after all! I want to learn from your example, Trainer <username>, and devote myself fully to this cause!
choice_data_list: So I'm fully devoting myself to it as well?
So I'm fully devoting myself to it as well?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Naturally! …Oop, look at the time!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: My schedule is packed with meetings for this project, so I need to get back to the office right away. Thank you for your time today!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There she goes. She blows in and out of here like a whirlwind…
choice_data_list: I hear you on that one…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, have you seen this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tazuna hands me a magazine. Among the lineup of features covering powerhouse runners is an article on <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: These are the top contenders for the title of "greatest." …What do you think?
choice_data_list: To be honest, I'm ecstatic. But…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But?
choice_data_list: One day, I want to see an entire issue dedicated to her!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh my! I know how you feel, though. An article this small does leave a little to be desired.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Special Issue on <chrname>, the Greatest Umamusume! Hehe, I look forward to reading that someday. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure <chrname> will emerge from this series as more than a mere contender.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During our training session later that day, I'm bursting with even more motivation than usual!
